notes: CLM zero-flux base at the hardpan matches the perched reservoir

zbedrock_basis: Calcareous sand, no rock in the 1.45 m pit; probes to 1.8 m; top 2.5 m monitored and dried out (D01-D02)
organic_basis: f09 kept

zbedrock_basis: Only atlas thicknesses (A 0.15 + B 1.29 = 1.44 m, D02); probes to 0.5 m. No site description of a restrictive layer
organic_basis: f09 kept

organic_basis: f09 kept

zbedrock_basis: Only atlas thicknesses (0.89 m, column likely copied from AU-DaS, D02); probes to 0.5 m
organic_basis: f09 kept

zbedrock_basis: Profile described to 2.42 m (C horizon 1.62-2.42 m) about 0.7 km from the tower (D01). f09 0.91 m is not supported
organic_basis: f09 kept

zbedrock_basis: Probes to 0.8 m; roots mostly in the upper 25 cm (D01-D02). No restrictive layer described
organic_basis: T1 secondary: ~11 kg C/m2 in the upper 20 cm of mineral soil at the Appi site (Koarashi et al. 2025 citing Koarashi et al. 2009; JP-Api-C11)

zbedrock_basis: Coarse volcanic-ash soil; moisture sensors to 0.2 m, soil temperature to 1 m (D01). No restrictive layer described
organic_basis: f09 kept
notes: Sensitivity candidate (ash depth ~1 m inferred from sensor depth only)

zbedrock_basis: On the Kenmarubi lava flow: almost no soil layer apart from litter and its decomposition products (D01; JapanFlux BIF SITE_DESC)
organic_basis: f09 kept
notes: 0.4 m is the shallowest value CLM honours (gives 0.48 m). Lava is fissured and permeable; CLM puts a zero-flux base at 0.48 m

zbedrock_basis: Schist brown forest soil; probes to 0.10 m only (D01-D02)
organic_basis: f09 kept

zbedrock_basis: Tensiometers to 0.9 m; groundwater gauge at 1.4 m (D01). No restrictive layer described
organic_basis: f09 kept; site 18.0 kg C/m2 without a depth (Yamanoi et al. 2015 citing Sakata et al. 2010; JP-Spp-C07), so not used for scaling
notes: A shallow water table is possible

zbedrock_basis: Soil organic matter inventoried to 1 m (Ohtsuka 2012 citing Jia and Akiyama 2005, D02); probes to 0.4 m
organic_basis: T1 secondary, lower bound: SOM pool >300 t C/ha to 1 m (Ohtsuka 2012 citing Jia and Akiyama 2005; JP-Tak-C06)

zbedrock_basis: O ~0.10 + A ~0.20 + B ~0.30 m over Cretaceous sedimentary rock (Takagi and Takahashi 2022, D01); probes to 0.6 m
organic_basis: T1: soil carbon 159 Mg C/ha to 1 m at CC-LaG in 2002 (Aguilos et al. 2014, Table 4; JP-Tef-C04)
notes: Gleyic Cambisol: wet profile; rock contact not stated

zbedrock_basis: Volcanic-ash loam ~2 m over Joso clay; water table within these layers (D01-D02)
organic_basis: f09 kept (site OC 4.9 % at 0-20 cm gives 59-94 kg/m3 vs f09 104)

zbedrock_basis: A horizon ~0.10 m over a highly permeable volcanogenous (pumice) regosol at the former larch tower (Hirano et al. 2003, D01); roots in buried pumice 0.31-0.55 m in nearby profiles (JP-Tom D01-D02)
organic_basis: f09 kept; the nearest evidence is the JP-Tom basin (5.5 kg C/m2 to 1 m, about 5 km away on the same Tarumae tephra)
notes: Pumice is permeable, not root-impermeable as the soil topic had it; CLM base at 0.48 m

zbedrock_basis: Topsoil 5-10 cm on Tarumae ash; small roots in buried pumice gravel to 0.55+ m (TK01) or none below 0.31 m (TK02) (D01-D03)
organic_basis: T1N: ~5500 g C/m2 from the O horizon to 100 cm in the tower basin (Shibata et al. 2005; JP-Tom-C01)

zbedrock_basis: Thin, immature sandy soil on weathering granite (two tower papers, D02-D03); probes to 0.26 m. Weathered granite is usually root-permeable, so no hard limit is set
organic_basis: f09 kept; site 30.0 Mg C/ha without a depth (Kominami et al. 2008; JP-Yms-C08), so not used for scaling
notes: Sensitivity candidate (47 cm soil depth seen only in a search excerpt)
